root.label: Aggregates
root.note: Types initialized element by element, with no constructor in charge.

children.label: Definition by version
children.note: Arrays always qualify; the class rules changed in every standard since C++11.

children.label: C++14
children.note: Default member initializers no longer disqualify a class.

children.label: C++17
children.note: Public non-virtual bases allowed; explicit or inherited constructors disqualify.

children.label: C++20
children.note: Any user-declared constructor, even = default or = delete, disqualifies.

children.label: Never disqualifying
children.note: Member functions, statics, a user-declared destructor and assignment operators.

children.label: Aggregate initialization
children.note: Elements, bases first, are copy-initialized in order from the list.

children.label: Omitted elements
children.note: Use the default member initializer, otherwise are initialized from {}.

children.label: No narrowing
children.note: Braced aggregate initialization rejects narrowing conversions.

children.label: Unions
children.note: Without a designator only the first member is initialized.

children.label: Brace elision
children.note: Inner braces may be dropped; {{1,2},{3,4}} fails for std::array<P,2>.

children.label: Base classes (C++17)
children.note: Each public base is an element initialized before the data members.

children.label: Derived{{1}, 2}
children.note: The base gets its own braces, or brace elision fills it.

children.label: Protected base ctor
children.note: Derived{} is ill-formed since C++17: the base is initialized from outside.

children.label: Designated (C++20)
children.note: Name members with .x = value, a deliberately narrow subset of C.

children.label: Declaration order
children.note: Designators must follow member order, unlike C.

children.label: All or none
children.note: Designated and positional clauses cannot be mixed.

children.label: No nesting or indices
children.note: No .a.b, no [2] = x, and bases cannot be named.

children.label: Union member choice
children.note: A single designator picks the union's active member.

children.label: Parentheses (C++20)
children.note: T(args...) aggregate-initializes when no constructor is viable.

children.label: Library construction
children.note:
make_unique

(1, 2) and emplace_back(1, 2) now work for aggregates.

children.label: Narrowing allowed
children.note: N n(2.5) compiles and truncates, while N n{2.5} is ill-formed.

children.label: No lifetime extension
children.note: A temporary bound to a reference member dies at the end of the declaration.

children.label: CTAD for aggregates
children.note: C++20 synthesizes a deduction candidate from the element types.

children.label: No guide needed
children.note: Pair p{1, 2.0} deduces Pair<int, double> without a deduction guide.
